sections.title: ARCH Summer Institute: History of Architecture
sections.description: This is a non-credit course for entering Master of Architecture students. The course will cover western architecture from ancient Egypt to the modern age and will satisfy the history pre-requisite condition for matriculation in the fall. Course enrollment is by permit only.
